result.wokenByPhone: Wake packet sent from this phone

parental.title: Internet Time
parental.intro: During these periods this device has no internet; it stays on Wi-Fi and can still reach the router. Times are in the router's time zone. Each period takes effect as soon as it is saved.
parental.overnightHint: An end earlier than the start means that time on the next day.
parental.consequenceRules: The router reloads its firewall rules, which takes a few seconds.
parental.consequenceCut: When a period starts, the device's open connections are cut too, a video that is playing for example.
parental.footer: The app manages these rules; the firewall page shows them read-only. In time zones with daylight saving, a switch takes effect at the next firewall reload.

error.same: Start and end can't be the same
